# Game Boy ROM Fixtures

## dmg-acid2

- **Source:** https://github.com/mattcurrie/dmg-acid2
- **Release:** `v1.0`
- **Author:** Matt Currie
- **License:** MIT
- **ROM:** `dmg-acid2.gb`

The ROM is used as a public, redistributable Game Boy fixture for emulator development. In this phase, it is used to exercise ROM loading and cartridge-header parsing; its primary purpose is PPU validation.

The upstream license text is preserved in `DMG-ACID2-LICENSE`.
